components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one magenta action on a surface; request, approve, save.
components.css: .btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:0.5rem; min-height:38px; padding:0.5rem 0.95rem; border-radius:7px; border:1px solid var(--color-edge); background:var(--color-raised); color:var(--color-ink); font-size:0.875rem; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; transition: background-color 160ms, border-color 160ms, color 160ms, box-shadow 160ms; } .btn-accent { background:var(--color-accent); border-color:var(--color-accent); color:var(--color-accent-ink); } .btn-accent:hover { background:var(--color-accent-hover); border-color:var(--color-accent-hover); } .btn:active:not(:disabled) { transform:translateY(1px); } .btn:disabled { opacity:0.45; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Raised neutral action; everything that is not the one intent.
components.css: .btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:0.5rem; min-height:38px; padding:0.5rem 0.95rem; border-radius:7px; border:1px solid var(--color-edge); background:var(--color-raised); color:var(--color-ink); font-size:0.875rem; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; transition: background-color 160ms, border-color 160ms; } .btn:hover { background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-raised) 82%, var(--color-ink)); border-color:color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-edge) 72%, var(--color-ink)); }

components.name: Input
components.description: Text field with magenta focus border on a mixed canvas fill.
components.css: .input { width:100%; min-height:40px; padding:0.55rem 0.75rem; border-radius:7px; border:1px solid var(--color-edge); background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-canvas) 65%, var(--color-panel)); color:var(--color-ink); font-size:0.9rem; font:inherit; } .input:focus { border-color:var(--color-accent); outline:none; } .input::placeholder { color:color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-muted) 78%, var(--color-panel)); }

components.name: Media Card
components.description: Poster card; whole card is the target, hover lifts art and magenta-edges.

components.css: .card { display:block; width:100%; text-align:left; background:var(--color-panel); border:1px solid var(--color-edge); border-radius:10px; overflow:hidden; cursor:pointer; padding:0; } .card:hover { border-color:var(--color-accent); } .media-card:hover .media-art { box-shadow:0 6px 20px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5); } .media-art img { display:block; width:100%; transition:transform 220ms; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Small status/label pill; accent variant on magenta-soft.
components.css: .chip { display:inline-block; padding:0.15rem 0.55rem; border-radius:5px; border:1px solid var(--color-edge); font-size:0.75rem; color:var(--color-muted); background:var(--color-raised); } .chip-accent { color:var(--color-accent-text); border-color:color-mix(in oklab, var(--color-accent) 45%, var(--color-panel)); background:var(--color-accent-soft); }

narrative.overview: Velvarr is a plum-dark room where the only light comes from the artwork on the walls. The magenta marquee marks every action; UI is architecture — quiet panels, measured tones, nothing brighter than the posters. M3 in its science (one key color, tone distance as contrast, every pair measured), Seerr in its grammar (poster-first cards, real request states). Chrome chroma stays under 0.04 on hue 325; neutrals rotate off the key hue so darks read plum, never brown.
keyCharacteristics: Single magenta voice for intent on tonal plum architecture
Flat by default, shadow only on touch (hover pop, overlay scrim)
Status hues (mint/info/ember) speak only for status, one shared palette
Measured WCAG pairs, documented in globals.css

rules.name: The Artwork Owns the Light
rules.body: Chrome chroma ≤ 0.04; the only saturated, bright thing on screen is provider artwork.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Magenta means intent — actions, focus, hover, selection — and nothing else.

rules.name: Earned Depth
rules.body: Tone + 1px edge at rest; shadows appear on touch or as overlay scrims only.

rules.name: Truth in Status
rules.body: Badges render real state from src/lib/status.ts; never fake or embellish a status.

dos: Do separate with tone distance + 1px edge (color-mix for blends)
Do keep focus rings 2px accent at 4px offset, :focus-visible only
donts: Don't fake data or status — honesty is the product
Don't add a second accent hue, gradient text, or decorative glass
Don't float resting surfaces with ambient shadows
Don't alter the credit or the mobile More-sheet navigation without a card
